title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: A confidence interval gives a range of values that is likely to contain the true parameter value. A 95% confidence interval means we are 95% confident that the true parameter lies within this range.

title: Interpreting Confidence Intervals
text: If a confidence interval for a parameter includes zero, it suggests that the parameter might not have a significant effect. Consider what this means for the intervals given for \( $$\theta_1$$ \) and \( $$\theta_2$$ \).

title: Evaluating \( $$\theta_0$$ \)
text: Does the confidence interval for \( $$\theta_0$$ \) suggest a significant effect?

title: Evaluating \( $$\theta_1$$ \)
text: Does the confidence interval for \( $$\theta_1$$ \) include zero?
